tei:div.tei:p: par skrun gyi byung rim brjod pa/

'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung las 'khrungs pa bcu phrag rig pa'i bdag nyid chen po kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum rin po che ni smin grol gyi gdams pas phyug cing bshad sgrub kyi yig cha dang*/ chos 'byung*/ rig gnas/ cho ga phyag len sogs mdor na chos spyod kyi bya ba che phra ci la 'jug dgos kyang ma tshang ba med pa lta bu ches rmad du byung ba'i chos mdzod rin po che zhig yin/ kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum rin po che 'di'i nang rgyud bzhi'i mchan bu them spang ma dang*/ rin chen ril nag grang sbyor che che 'bring chung sogs kyi man ngag ni bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus thog che mthong dang ldan pa'i nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu zhig yin zhing*/ de dang de 'dra'i gdams zab ches mang ba zhig kyang bzhugs pa rnams mjal blos dang spel blos bzod dka' ba'i gnas su gyur par brten/ sngon 'bri gung khul du kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum bris ma kha shas las med khar/ de dag gi glegs thag la dam sbyar gyis mjal yul dang bral zhing*/ dmigs bsal gyi ljags lung zhu ba'i skabs su'ang bsnyen bkur zhus te zhal phye dgos lugs thos/ kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum 'di bar lam dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis 'bri gung khul du gsung 'bum pod kha shas las mjal yul ma gyur rung*/ bod khams nang chen khul dpal me dgon du chos grags kyi gsung 'bum cha tshang zhig bzhugs yod pa ni kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i dngos slob lho dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal zhu ba nang chen rgyal po'i dbu blar phebs skabs/ gsung 'bum tshar gcig 'dra bshus kyis mnyam du bsnams phebs pa yin lugs gsung 'bum de ga'i mjug byang du gsal 'dug pas/ de ni chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis sdong grogs mdzad pa'i mthong chos ngo mtshar ba'i gtam snyan zhig kyang yin/

lo ngo bdun tsam ring 'bad brtson brgyud mthar gsung 'bum rin po che rim pas snga rjes su rgya bal khul du gdan 'dren zhu thub pa byung thog /phral mar bal yul du rig mdzod sgrig chas gsar nyo dang*/ bod yig gi rig mdzod bya rim legs shos kyi nang du gsung ༄༅/ /'bum rin po che gsar bris byed 'go tshugs/ lo gcig lhag song rjes slar rgya gar du rig mdzod sgrig chas gsar nyos kyis gsung 'bum gsar bris kyi las don rnams 'bri gung bka' brgyud gtsug lag slob gnyer khang du las 'go tshugs shing*/ bar lam lo ngo lnga lhag tsam ring*/ 'bri gung gdan sa mthil gyi bla sprul mkhas dbang nub pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin rin po che mchog nas gtso 'gan bzhes te/ wā ṇā bod kyi mtho rim slob grwar slob sbyong gnang ba'i yo red tshang brtson 'grus seng ge dang*/ smon lam/ rig mdzod ched las pa nyi lcang dkon mchog nor bu dang*/ ma byan a 'brug bcas dmigs bsal tshogs chung nas snga lang phyi nyal dang*/ ma bskul dang blangs kyi 'bad brtson bcas zhus dag snga rjes thengs bdun tsam song yod pa dang*/ dag cha rnams rgya bod tshig mdzod chen por khungs gtugs shing*/ sngags kyi dag cha rnams 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i gdams ngag mdzod la gzhir bzhag ste/ spud tshad ang dang po dang myur tshad ang gnyis par bzhag pa'i rtsa 'dzin 'og las don rnams bde blag ngang legs grub byung bar bsngags brjod dang 'brel rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu yin/ kun mkhyen rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum gsar du par bskrun zhus pa 'di'i nang rgyud bzhi'i mchan bu rnams kha ma gsal bas da lam 'dir par skrun zhu thabs ma byung*/ de bzhin rtsis kyi skor gyi bstan bcos rnams kyang ma dpe kha 'thor bar brten deng bar lag son ma byung bar blo pham ci che yang*/ slad kyang ma dpe de rigs thob thabs byed rgyu dang don 'bras son mtshams su mu mthud par bskrun zhu rgyu yin/

de min sngar gsung 'bum nang du ma tshud pa'i gsung rtsom thar thor rigs mi nyung ba zhig kyang mthong rgyu 'dug pas rjes 'jug slob ma rnams kyis 'bad brtson gyis kha skong yong ba'i re ba yod/ da lam bka' 'bum rin po che ldi lir par skrun gyi las 'gan yang yo red tshang brtson 'grus seng ges khur blang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang 'brel/ bka' 'bum 'di bskrun pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ 'di phyi bstan 'gro'i bya ba 'byams klas par gyur cig gu/ zhes rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin kun bzang phrin las lhun grub kyis/ rab gnas sa stag snron zla'i yar tshes 15 'dzam gling spyi bsang nyin dang*/ spyi lo 1998 zla 7 tshes 25 nyin spel bas dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
